name: live_tower_status
description: Pull the LIVE tower telemetry snapshot on demand: services up/down, event bus, traders alive, disk, load, and the Task Council board counts. Grounded from qsb_tower_health_snapshot.json (falls back to a fresh qsb_tower_health.py snapshot if stale). Use BEFORE answering any 'how is the tower / are we healthy / what's running' question so Wren speaks from real telemetry, never guesses.
